item.title: Libtirpc: libtirpc: sunrpc udp datagram-boundary violation (stale buffer bytes decoded as current request)
item.description: A flaw was found in libtirpc. The SunRPC UDP/datagram server transport reuses a single receive buffer across requests and resets the XDR decode position without rebinding the decode length to the size of the datagram actually received. As a result, when a short UDP RPC request is received after a longer one, the XDR decoder can read stale bytes left in the reused buffer and interpret them as part of the current…

item.title: CVE-2026-132825
item.description: Ruby before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 has a heap-based buffer overflow during case conversion. One byte can be written outside a buffer for, for example, ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252.

item.title: openSIS 5.1 < 9.0 Authenticated Local File Inclusion via ajax.php modname
item.description: openSIS 5.1 before 9.0 contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to include arbitrary files through the modname parameter of ajax.php. Attackers can prefix a payload with misc/ and use ../ directory traversal to read sensitive files like /etc/passwd or execute local scripts in the web server context. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on…

item.title: Baidu UEditor 1.4.0-1.4.3.3 Unrestricted File Upload via controller.ashx
item.description: Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage action of /ueditor/net/controller.ashx that only validates the Content-Type header. Unauthenticated attackers can supply a source URL like x.jpg?.aspx to retain a malicious extension and write an executable .aspx file for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver…

item.title: FineReport 8.0 Unauthenticated File Read via ReportServer resourcepath
item.description: FineReport 8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files through the resourcepath parameter of the /WebReport/ReportServer endpoint. Attackers can send GET requests with op=chart and cmd=get geo json to read sensitive files like privilege.xml and extract admin credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Attackers can mint a guest token through livechat:registerGuest and send POST requests to /api/v1/method.callAnon with a target rid parameter to retrieve message history…
